samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Pulse detection logic. Detects rising edges of the input signal data_in and produces a one-cycle wide output pulse data_out at the end of the detected pulse sequence.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset input.</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="idle">Idle state</param>
        <param id="first_one">First one detected after idle</param>
        <param id="one_to_zero">Transitioning from one to zero</param>
        <param id="last_zero">Last zero before transitioning back to idle</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <state_register id="state">Current state of the pulse detection process.</state_register>
        <state_register id="next_state">Next state of the pulse detection process.</state_register>
        
        <signal id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <assign>state = ~rst_n ? idle : next_state;</assign>
        <always @(*) begin
            case(state)
                idle:       next_state <= data_in ? first_one : idle;
                first_one:  next_state <= data_in ? one_to_zero : idle;
                one_to_zero:begin
                    if(data_in == 0) next_state <= last_zero;
                    else              next_state <= one_to_zero;
                end
                last_zero:  next_state <= data_in ? idle : last_zero;
                default:    next_state <= idle;
            endcase
        end
        <always @(*) begin
            case(next_state)
                idle:           data_out <= 1'd0;
                first_one:      data_out <= 1'd0;
                one_to_zero:    data_out <= 1'd0;
                last_zero:      data_out <= 1'd1;
                default:        data_out <= 1'd0;
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
